captures.description: THE ARCHIVE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'The International Dada Archive is a premier scholarly research center for the historic Dada movement, housed at the University of Iowa Libraries in Iowa City, Iowa.' Overview and history (founded 1979 'following a 1978 international Dada conference'; location; scope as 'One of the world's largest repositories'); collection and resources (the Online Bibliography of roughly 60,000 titles, the Digital Dada Library, formats, Dada/Surrealism); an offer to guide the user. Four cards: the University of Iowa Libraries, People’s Graphic Design Archive, The Gazette, International Times.

atoms.evidence: International Dada Archive - University of Iowa Libraries
housed at the University of Iowa Libraries in Iowa City, Iowa.
Established in 1979 following a 1978 international Dada conference hosted at the university.
is a premier scholarly research center for the historic Dada movement
The archive's primary catalog containing roughly 60,000 titles of books, articles, and resources by and about Dadaists.
